identity.authentication: Control-plane-issued credential or signed identity assertion validated outside the model; agent-supplied text fields are never proof.
identity.revocation_effect: Reject new tasks and handoffs immediately; cancel queued work; request cooperative cancellation of running work; terminate runtime through an external supervisor where available; invalidate session credentials; preserve audit evidence.

capability_profiles.principle: Explicit allowlists by company, role, task, resource, operation and environment.
capability_profiles.secrets: Never place secrets in prompts, task payloads, agent memory, repository files or ordinary logs. Use a separately controlled secret broker only after explicit approval and least-privilege review.
capability_profiles.runtime: Sandboxed; no unrestricted host filesystem, shell, browser, network or MCP access.

invariants: company_id must match issuer and assignee unless a separately approved cross-company data contract exists
task scope cannot exceed issuer authority or assignee capability profile
task cannot alter identity, role, capability profile, policy, budget ceiling or audit records
cost ceiling is enforced by a deterministic meter before any billable call
expired or replayed tasks are rejected
idempotency key is unique within company and task operation scope
task output must conform to declared schema or be rejected/quarantined

handoff.cross_company: Denied by default. Requires owner-approved, purpose-limited, field-limited, time-limited data-sharing contract; receiving company must independently accept the task. No transfer of credentials, secrets, private memory, ledgers, customer records or risk authority.
handoff.model_routing: A model may recommend a recipient; only the deterministic scheduler may assign work within approved policies.
handoff.delegation: Child tasks inherit or narrow parent scope; they cannot expand permissions, cost caps or approval authority.

retry_rules: Retries require bounded attempt count and backoff
Only idempotent operations may be retried automatically
A retry cannot reset expiry, cost cap or approval requirements
Ambiguous external outcomes are quarantined for reconciliation, not blindly repeated
lifecycle.cancellation: Cancellation is an out-of-band control-plane action, not a model suggestion. Stop new child tasks, revoke task-scoped grants and record whether the runtime acknowledged cancellation.
lifecycle.timeout: Enforce task deadline externally; timeout transitions to failed or cancelled and revokes task-scoped capabilities.

approvals.authority: Owner or explicitly delegated human approver through an authenticated approval channel.
rules: Approval is action-specific, resource-specific, amount-capped and time-limited
No approval may be inferred from silence, model output, swarm consensus or previous unrelated approval
No agent may approve its own request
Any material change to action, amount, recipient or resource requires a new approval

audit.tamper_evidence: Hash-linked or equivalently tamper-evident records; integrity verification must be implemented and tested.
